reviewed_by: Codex Quiet Lens Session rail contour review
reason: The change replaces the collapsed Quiet Lens Session rail CSS ellipse with the same SVG contour used by the navigation handle. Twenty-five collected SideNav component cases cover the touched navigation component. Ten catalogued Quiet Lens browser cases cover first-run theme behavior and the real rail reveal journey at 1440/1024 px desktop Chromium and 320/390/430 px emulated mobile Chromium and WebKit widths. The desktop rail journey compares rendered contours, checks clipping, and verifies hover, focus, attention, and idle states. A production UI build checks the shipped CSS and SVG output.
exclusions: No Core API, database, provider, native runtime, or origin-sensitive behavior changes, so Python and native tests are unrelated and a real-Core mutation journey is not selected. Other chat, workspace, and browser suites are excluded. Mobile devices are emulated; no physical-device result is claimed.
